quests.title: One Giant Step for Alchemy?

dialogue.t: ...Traveler! Hi! Hold up a second...
Okay, so... I'm sorry about this, but... there's something I really need your help with.
As you know, I've never made much progress in my alchemical studies...
Well, I've realized that I can't keep trying the same things over and over again. Clearly, that approach is getting me nowhere.
So, I decided I'd change focus. Take a fresh approach. Attempt something that's not been done before...

dialogue.sit: You're going back to the origins of the art?

dialogue.t: There's nothing particularly new about bio-alchemy. There are already people researching that.
You mean study the alchemical arts of the ancients? No, that's not something I'd be able to get involved in...
Do you know what the most important factor in alchemy is? It's the elements.
For a number of reasons, alchemy is mostly performed using items infused with elemental energy, rather than pure elemental energy itself.
Naturally, this introduces impurities into the transmutation process, making the elemental reactions less effective...
To compensate, we must use larger quantities of elemental materials. Even then, we still need to be very hands-on during the transmutation process, as the impurities can easily ruin the outcome.
Unfortunately, this all creates extra costs for those who wish to perform alchemy without using Visions.
The biggest issue is that items infused with elemental energy do not come cheap.
The bill for the average transmutation is more astonishing than the fruits of our labor...
*sigh* Maybe this is why I've never made any tangible progress. The barrier to entry is just too high...

dialogue.sit: I don't have a Vision, either.
Here's the thing: I've come up with a new kind of alchemical furnace which I call the Elemental Crucible. The idea behind it is...

dialogue.t: True... But I hear you can still manipulate elemental energy, correct?
Here's the thing: I've come up with a new kind of alchemical furnace which I call the Elemental Crucible. The idea behind it is...
Well, basically, it's a vessel that can hold pure elemental energy and generate elemental reactions.
With any luck, the Elemental Crucible will be the thing that takes my alchemical skills to the next level...
Everything is set up and ready to go. All I'm missing now is someone with the ability to actually move the pure elemental energy around.
If you're willing to help out, please meet me at the Thousand Winds Temple. That's where I had some people set everything up.
I really hope this will be my big breakthrough in alchemy...
There you are. So, here it is — the Elemental Crucible.
Let's fire it up and see if it works.
Just need to activate it a few more times...
Traveler! Just who I wanted to see. Do you remember that Elemental Crucible I made?
After you activated it, I was able to gather a fair bit of data from the sidelines.
Most importantly, I was able to determine its reliability.
With such reliable apparatus, we will be able to perform even more experiments from now on.
If you're willing to help, Traveler, could you help me activate the Elemental Crucible once more?

dialogue.sit: How many experiments would you like to conduct?

dialogue.t: Many thanks.
The more the merrier, of course. For a Vision-less alchemist like myself, these brute-force measures are the only way I can do research...
So please help me activate the Elemental Crucible again. I'll be in your debt, Traveler.

quests.description: In an effort to hone his alchemical skills, Timaeus has designed an all-new alchemical furnace. There's just one problem — he needs some help to get it working...
